IRepoSettingsStrategy uses getSettings/updateSettings naming while sibling strategies use bare list/get/create/update/delete verbs
Force-merge privilege use (--admin / --bypass-policy) logs a warning but is not recorded in a durable audit sink
Docstring 'Render a leaf tree node (no children) with its value' sits above hasComplexValue predicate — belongs to the renderer functions below
V2/V3 manifest migration paths in src/sync/manifest.ts have no documented sunset criteria
test/unit/ mirrors src/ structure inconsistently — 57 flat files coexist with 6 domain subdirectories
src/shared/sanitize-utils.ts has 100% of production importers inside src/vcs/ — misplaced in shared-kernel
src/repo/ is the only production domain folder without an index.ts barrel; detector.ts re-exports serve as a makeshift substitute
sync-command.ts keeps _defaultExecutor and _logger as module-scope `let` caches; concurrent runSync calls would race
program.ts performs readFileSync(package.json) at module scope via program.version(getVersion())
RepoIterationContext flattens 4 processor factories alongside 9 other fields instead of grouping them.
validateSettings in src/config/validator.ts mixes 5 distinct top-level validations in one ~100-line body.
rethrowIfUnexpectedCommitError is named 'rethrow' but always returns a result — never throws
GitOps.commit @returns contract claims false when no staged changes, but dry-run returns true unconditionally
deepEqual returns `a === b` in a branch where `a !== b` is already known, making the expression statically false
ghApiCall uses `return await withRetry(...)` outside any surrounding try/catch, making the `await` keyword cosmetic

dimension_notes_summary.contract_coherence: Error contracts on IPRStrategy, IRepoLifecycleProvider, and IRepoLifecycleFactory are well-documented with @throws annotations that match implementations
dimension_notes_summary.logic_clarity: Exhaustive switch statements with never checks in lifecycle-report.ts, lifecycle-formatter.ts, and diff-utils.ts ensure all discriminated union variants are handled
dimension_notes_summary.type_safety: strict: true enabled in tsconfig.json with full TypeScript strict mode

review_issue_summaries.summary: output/lifecycle-report.ts imports LifecycleActionKind directly from lifecycle/types.ts, bypassing the barrel
output/sync-report.ts imports formatDiffLine from sync/, creating a backwards dependency for a pure utility
output/ is the only top-level package without a barrel index.ts, breaking the codebase convention
Code-scanning test files use domain-prefixed names unlike sibling settings test directories
Lifecycle module redundantly prefixes file names with lifecycle- unlike peer modules
writeGitHubStepSummary logs I/O failure at debug level instead of warn
ISettingsProcessor.process() uses generic 'process' verb where 'applySettings' or 'syncSettings' would communicate intent
ResultsCollector.findOrCreate silently creates entries — name suggests lookup but mutates state
AuthenticatedGitOps forwards 18 ILocalGitOps methods as pure pass-through with no added behavior
receiveMigration mixes 5 sequential concerns in a single ~80-line method: origin cleanup, ref cleanup, branch rename, repo creation, and mirror push
buildSettingsDescriptors repeats near-identical descriptor objects 4 times, differing only in key, label, and field assignment
Settings descriptor pattern in sync-command.ts uses per-kind assignment callbacks with type assertions, creating glue-code entropy
Token resolution occurs in both sync-command.ts and AuthOptionsBuilder, creating an implicit coordination requirement
output/settings-report.ts (378 LOC) and output/sync-report.ts (140 LOC) lack dedicated unit tests for formatting logic
Some processor tests verify mock call sequences rather than behavioral outcomes, creating implementation coupling
receiveMigration bundles 4 distinct operations (ref cleanup, branch rename, create repo, push mirror) in one 133-line method
diffRepoSettings omits unchanged entries unlike sibling diff functions, making hasRepoSettingsChanges a dead filter
Duplicate deepEqual implementations in diff.ts and diff-algorithm.ts within the same rulesets module
Redundant typeof === 'object' check on codeScanning in hasActionableSettings
baseResult<TResult> casts BaseProcessorResult to any TResult subtype without compile-time safety
